description: This file defines HTTP API handlers for managing blocks within boards, including CRUD operations, duplication, and batch updates, with authorization and auditing.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API struct that contains methods for handling HTTP requests related to blocks.

methods.name: registerBlocksRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP routes for block operations.

methods.name: handleGetBlocks
methods.description: Handles retrieving blocks for a specific board, with filtering options.

methods.name: handlePostBlocks
methods.description: Handles inserting or updating multiple blocks.

methods.name: handleUndeleteBlock
methods.description: Handles undeleting a previously deleted block.

methods.name: handlePatchBlock
methods.description: Handles partial update of a specific block.

methods.name: handlePatchBlocks
methods.description: Handles batch partial updates of multiple blocks.

methods.name: handleDuplicateBlock
methods.description: Handles duplicating a block, optionally as a template.
